query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed password*")
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*Accepted*",
        failed   = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*Failed password*",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC
